Bill.BriefDescription: Providing sales and use tax exemptions for light and power businesses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to sales and use tax exemptions for light and powerbusinesses; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 82.12 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 shall not apply to sales ofmachinery and equipment used directly in generating electricity bylight and power businesses in new generation facilities, but only ifthe purchaser provides the seller with an exemption certificate in aform and manner prescribed by the department. The seller shall retaina copy of the certificate for the seller's files. (2) For purposes of this section and section 2 of this act: (a) "Light and power business" has the same meaning as defined RCW82.16.010. (b) "Machinery and equipment" means industrial fixtures, devices,and support facilities that are integral and necessary to thegeneration of electricity. p. 1 SB 5508 (c) "Machinery and equipment" does not include: (i) Handpoweredtools; (ii) property with a useful life of less than one year; (iii)repair parts required to restore machinery and equipment to normalworking order; (iv) replacement parts that do not increaseproductivity, improve efficiency, or extend the useful life ofmachinery and equipment; (v) buildings; or (vi) building fixtures thatare not integral and necessary to the generation of electricity thatare permanently affixed to and become a physical part of a building. (d) Machinery and equipment is "used directly" in generatingelectricity if it is part of the process that converts any type ofnonelectrical energy into electricity. (e) "New generation facilities" do not include facilities inexistence prior to the effective date of this act and are limited togasfired generation.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply in respect to theuse by a light and power business of machinery and equipment useddirectly in generating electricity in new generation facilities. (2) The definitions in section 1 of this act apply to this section.
